screens.prompt:
A right-side slide-out Notification Inbox Sheet, 420px wide, following the Monochrome Logic design system (dark mode, Inter font, deep blacks #131313, subtle borders). 

Structure:
- Header: Title 'Notifications' with an urgent count badge '2', and a close 'X' icon.
- Section 1: 'Needs your attention' (2 items). 
    - Item 1: 'Calendar invite approval', meta: 'User • High • 2m ago'. Red left border for HIGH priority. Icon: 'calendar_today'.
    - Item 2: 'Save research', meta: 'System • High • 15m ago'. Icon: 'save'.
- Section 2: 'Today' (4 items).
    - Item 1: 'Email flagged', meta: 'User • Low • 1h ago'. Icon: 'flag'.
    - Item 2: '3 new emails', meta: 'System • Low • 2h ago'. Icon: 'mail'.
    - Item 3: 'Daily research done', meta: 'Agent • Low • 4h ago'. Icon: 'check_circle'.
    - Item 4: 'Invoice digest done', meta: 'Agent • Low • 5h ago'. Icon: 'check_circle'.
- Section 3: 'Earlier' (2 items).
    - Item 1: 'Agent release v1.2', meta: 'System • Info • 1d ago'. Icon: 'update'.
    - Item 2: 'Integration error: Datadog', meta: 'System • Med • 2d ago'. Icon: 'report_problem'.

Styling:
- Use deep blacks (#131313) for background.
- Subtle borders for separation.
- Title bold 12px for items. Meta line below.
- Icon on the left for each item.
- Hover background effects on items.
- NO purple, NO neon. Strictly monochrome/grayscale except for the specific red priority indicator.
- The sheet should appear as an overlay on the right side of the screen.

outputComponents.text:
I've designed the **Notification Inbox Sheet** as a 420px right-side slide-out, fully integrated with the **Monochrome Logic** design system. 

### Design Choices:
- **Layout:** A clean, vertical drawer layout that provides high density without sacrificing legibility.
- **Visual Hierarchy:** 
    - **Urgent Priority:** The "Calendar invite approval" item features a distinct red left border to signal high importance, contrasting with the strictly monochrome palette.
    - **Categorization:** Clearly defined sections ("Needs your attention," "Today," "Earlier") help users scan and prioritize their workload.
- **Typography:** Used Inter with a bold 12px weight for item titles and a refined meta line for actors and timestamps, maintaining a technical, developer-first aesthetic.
- **Interactivity:** Added subtle hover states for items to provide clear feedback during navigation.

The design strictly avoids non-brand colors like purple or neon, sticking to deep blacks and subtle grays for a professional look.
